Original VirelaiOS fixtures, repository LICENSE.

dct-gray-32.jpg: byte-identical copy of
user/go/webrender/testdata/jpeg/gray-32.jpg — a 32x32 grayscale baseline
(SOF0, 8-bit, Huffman) JPEG generated from a specified pixel function by the
in-tree jpegEncode in user/go/webrender/jpeg_test.go; no downloaded input or
external decoder implementation. See that directory's SOURCES.txt.

dct.pdf: authored one-page PDF (96x72 pt MediaBox, 128x96 px at 96 dpi)
whose single /Im1 XObject embeds dct-gray-32.jpg as a /DCTDecode stream,
placed 1:1 (24pt = 32px) centered on the page. Generated by tools/pdf-proof/corpus.py's
document/stream helpers for the go-reader gate's DCT leg (#2988); the
generator invocation is recorded in tools/gate/specs/go-reader.spec.
